shots.title: The map
shots.music: Keys and voice alone. No drums.
shots.visual: A blank sheet of paper. The documentary's tracking map inks itself on: coastline, contour lines, a grid, a cluster of dots labelled THE COLONY at far left, and at far right a small ink peak marker (a dome with a jutting spur) labelled MOUNTAINS. A dotted measuring line crawls from the colony to the marker.
shots.action: None. The penguin is a single dot in the colony cluster, the only dot facing the other way.
shots.framing: Full-frame graphic, top-down
shots.move: Locked, with a slow drift toward the marker (zoom 1.00 to 1.04)
shots.color: Paper, ink, grey contour lines. No wash.
shots.animation: Lines draw on as ink strokes (stroke-dashoffset) with a slight wobble. The dotted line advances one dot per eighth note. `70 KM` stamps down on "-meters" with a 2-frame squash.
shots.fx: Paper grain; a faint ink bleed on the stamp
shots.out: REC pop. The UI blinks on and the image cuts to the camera's live view.
shots.purpose: State the stakes (the distance) before the story starts
shots.head: none

beats.do: measuring line starts at the colony

shots.title: The colony
shots.music: Voice and keys
shots.visual: The documentary's first live shot, telephoto from a low rise: hundreds of penguins packed on a trampled shore, every one facing the sea at screen left. We see a field of black backs. In the middle of it, one white front faces the camera: him, facing inland.
shots.action: He stands still, looking past the camera, inland. Everyone else looks at the sea.
shots.framing: Telephoto wide; the colony fills the lower two thirds; the dark sea strip at the top
shots.move: Handheld drift; exposure settles from white in 10 frames
shots.color: Paper with a cold blue-grey wash; the DOC grade on top
shots.animation: Colony crowd idles (seeded shuffles); the sea's ice floes drift
shots.fx: Viewfinder UI (REC, TC, battery), video noise, vignette
shots.out: Cut on the beat to the tighter DOC shot
shots.purpose: The outsider image. One face in a crowd of backs.
shots.head: frown

beats.do: power-on: black, REC dot, UI elements pop in one per 2 frames

shots.title: Heads turn
shots.music: The quiet, high background vocal echo; keys
shots.visual: Tighter telephoto. The focus brackets hunt across the crowd, overshoot, come back and lock on him. Snap zoom. As the background voices echo, the penguins around him turn their heads to look at him in a slow wave that ripples outward.
shots.action: He doesn't look back at them. His eyes stay on the horizon beyond the camera. One slow blink.
shots.framing: Telephoto medium-wide, him centered in the brackets with a ring of neighbors
shots.move: Handheld; snap zoom 1.0 to 1.6 with overshoot at 4.1
shots.color: Blue-grey wash, DOC grade
shots.animation: The head-turn wave (each neighbor 2 frames after the last, rippling outward)
shots.fx: Focus-hunt blur pulses; lower third types on
shots.out: Letterbox slam on "Se-" of the second "Seventy". The UI blinks off.
shots.purpose: "They" are the colony. Social pressure, shown as a gag.
shots.head: frown

beats.do: snap zoom and lock on him
head-turn wave begins, 2 frames per penguin

shots.title: His horizon
shots.music: Voice returns full; light hats and snare begin
shots.visual: His point of view for the first time, over his shoulder: the edge of the trampled colony ground, then an empty white plain to the horizon. On the horizon at screen right, barely darker than the sky, a speck: the mountain.
shots.action: The back of his head and his crest at frame left; the crest stirs in the wind
shots.framing: Over-the-shoulder, lens at his eye height; horizon at 58%
shots.move: Slow push-in toward the speck (zoom 1.00 to 1.12 over the shot)
shots.environment: The plain seen from the colony's edge
shots.light: Pre-dawn, with a faint lighter band at the horizon
shots.color: Cold paper; pale blue-grey sky wash
shots.animation: Ground drift skims right to left, against him
shots.fx: Letterbox (2.39:1) from here on in CINEMA shots
shots.purpose: The destination is seen before it is named. The mountain is tiny.
shots.head: profile

shots.title: The edge
shots.music: Voice, keys, hats and snare; still no kick
shots.visual: Extreme close-up of his feet at the boundary: behind them, snow trampled grey by thousands of feet; in front, untouched paper-white snow.
shots.action: His toes spread and grip the edge. One foot lifts a centimeter and settles again.
shots.framing: ECU, lens on the ground
shots.color: Grey trampled snow vs. paper white
shots.animation: Toe flex; a few grains of snow roll forward over the line
shots.purpose: The threshold, made physical
shots.head: none

shots.title: Refrain R1 · the edge of everything
shots.music: "…began": the long high note, the intro's peak; percussion building, no kick yet
shots.visual: The Refrain frame, first time. Locked wide. At left, the colony: a low grey smudge of bodies. At the left third line, him, alone at the edge of the trampled ground. To the right, the empty plain, and on the horizon at the right third line, the speck of the mountain.
shots.action: He holds still through the long note while the wind lifts a veil of snow past him. On the last beat he lifts his foot.
shots.framing: EWS, horizon at 58%, him on the left third, the mountain on the right third
shots.environment: The colony's edge and the plain
shots.light: Pre-dawn turning to first light (the horizon band lightens, no warm color)
shots.color: Blue-grey wash thinning toward the horizon
shots.animation: A drift veil crosses the frame on beat 3 of bar 7; the foot lifts on 8.4
shots.out: Cut on the "I'm" pickup to the foot coming down
shots.purpose: The Refrain composition is established; everything the song leaves behind is in frame
shots.head: profile

beats.do: drift veil crosses left to right

shots.title: The first step
shots.music: The full band enters on the downbeat of bar 9
shots.visual: Extreme close-up: his foot comes down onto untouched snow and presses a clean print into it exactly on the downbeat. Powder puffs out around the toes.
shots.action: The step
shots.framing: ECU, lens on the snow
shots.move: Locked; a 2-frame camera jolt on impact
shots.color: Paper; the print's shadow in pale blue-grey
shots.animation: Foot contact on 9.1; the footprint draws in over 3 frames; spray particles
shots.purpose: The journey starts on the music's biggest entrance
shots.head: none

shots.title: Striding out
shots.music: Full band
shots.visual: Low side tracking shot. He strides out of frame-left into open snow, head high.
shots.action: The walk begins: one step per beat, long legs, a slight waddle roll, head held level. Eyes locked on the mountain ahead (off frame right).
shots.framing: Low MS, side view, lens 30 cm off the snow
shots.move: Tracks right with him at walking speed
shots.color: Pale; light grey sky wash
shots.animation: Beat-locked walk cycle; footprints spawn on contact frames
shots.purpose: His gait, introduced as character
shots.head: profile

shots.title: Refrain R2 · walking out alone
shots.music: Full band
shots.visual: White-out. The sky and the snow are the same paper white; the horizon has gone. A single dark dot crosses the page, trailing a thin line of footprints back to the left edge.
shots.action: He walks, tiny
shots.framing: EWS; the Refrain frame with no visible horizon; the mountain is lost in the white
shots.color: Almost pure paper; the only ink is him and his prints
shots.animation: Walk at 1 step per beat, too small to read as more than a bob
shots.purpose: Isolation from scale, not from a sad face
shots.head: profile

shots.title: The look back
shots.music: Full band, kick lighter
shots.visual: He stops and turns to face back the way he came. Far behind him at the horizon, the colony is a grey smudge. The shot faces him with the colony over his shoulder.
shots.action: He turns around (beats 1-2), looks at the colony (beat 3), one slow blink, and on beat 4 starts to turn away.
shots.framing: MS, three-quarter front, the colony smudge on the horizon behind his shoulder
shots.environment: The plain, the colony far behind
shots.color: Pale grey
shots.animation: The turn, the blink, the start of the turn back
shots.out: Whip pan in the direction of his turn (12 frames); the cut hides in the blur on 12.1
shots.purpose: This is his one look back in the first act: "Turn my back on…"
shots.head: frown

beats.do: begins the turn away; whip pan starts

shots.title: Everything I know
shots.music: Full band
shots.visual: The reverse, from inside the colony: the soft backs of three penguins fill the foreground. Far away past them, a tiny dark figure walks away toward the horizon.
shots.action: He walks away, small. Two of the foreground penguins turn their heads to watch him go, then turn back to the sea.
shots.framing: Wide, foreground backs out of focus
shots.environment: The colony's edge and the plain beyond
shots.color: Grey foreground, pale background
shots.animation: Foreground head turns on beats 2 and 3
shots.purpose: What he is leaving, seen from what he is leaving
shots.head: none

shots.title: Knocked flat
shots.music: Full band, kick strong on the downbeat
shots.visual: Locked medium shot. A gust hits him on the downbeat and he goes straight over backwards, flat on his back, feet in the air.
shots.action: Down on beat 1. He lies there for a beat, staring at the sky (annoyed). Up on beat 3. Full-body snow shake on beat 4.
shots.framing: MS side, locked
shots.move: Locked (the gag needs a still frame)
shots.color: Pale
shots.animation: Fall with a 2-frame squash on landing; the 8-frame body shake
shots.fx: Gust streaks (P02) and a puff of snow
shots.purpose: "Nothing's going my way" as slapstick, played deadpan
shots.head: annoyed

shots.title: My own way
shots.music: Full band, kick lighter
shots.visual: High angle. The colony's worn trail, a road of thousands of footprints, curves away left toward the sea. He is on it. He steps onto a patch of blue ice, his feet shoot out, and he belly-slides straight off the trail to the right across untouched snow, leaving one clean groove.
shots.action: Slip on beat 1, belly down on beat 2, sliding through beats 2-4. He realizes it's going the right way and rides it (smirk).
shots.framing: High-angle wide
shots.move: Slow pan right with the slide
shots.environment: The colony trail, a blue-ice patch, untouched snow
shots.color: Grey trail, paper snow, a pale blue wash on the ice
shots.animation: Slip, belly flop, slide with a long groove drawn behind him
shots.purpose: "So I'll go my own way": his own way starts by accident, and he keeps it
shots.head: smirk
sung: So I'll go my own way
I feel it, I can't explain…

shots.title: I feel it
shots.music: Full band
shots.visual: He gets up out of the slide and goes still, in profile, facing the horizon.
shots.action: He stands. His head tilts 8°, his pupils widen, his flippers lower slowly. He is listening to something.
shots.framing: MCU profile
shots.color: Pale
shots.animation: The stillness; only feathers and crest move in the wind
shots.out: Cut on beat 3 to his POV
shots.purpose: A feeling he can't explain, shown as stillness
shots.head: profile

shots.title: The first breath
shots.music: Full band
shots.visual: His POV. The mountain on the horizon, small and crisp for the first time. A plume of snow lifts off the summit and drifts left, toward him, like a breath.
shots.action: None (POV)
shots.framing: POV, the mountain centered small; the summit spur pointing at the lens
shots.move: Locked, with a very slow push
shots.light: Overcast breaking; a paler patch of sky behind the mountain
shots.color: Pale; the plume in paper white against a grey wash
shots.animation: The plume rises and dissipates over 4 beats
shots.out: Horizon hold into the time-lapse; the horizon line stays put and the DOC UI pops on
shots.purpose: Seed 1 of the reveal, the breath
shots.head: none

shots.title: Every day
shots.music: The lift. Kick and bass drop out under a bright riser.
shots.visual: The documentary's locked-off time-lapse camera on a tripod. The same horizon, but the light races: the sun wheels overhead, shadows sweep, and night blinks by twice. Each "day" a tiny penguin appears further along, walking. The data overlay ticks along with it.
shots.action: He crosses the frame again and again, further each time
shots.framing: Wide, locked
shots.light: Accelerated day/night cycles (3 days in 1.8 s)
shots.color: DOC grade; washes cycle day-blue, night-navy, day-blue
shots.animation: Day/night cycle; his position steps once per beat
shots.fx: Viewfinder UI with a TIME-LAPSE tag; timecode races
shots.out: Letterbox slam on the pickup "I'm the"
shots.purpose: "Walking every day": time passing, shown as the documentary's time-lapse
shots.head: profile

shots.title: He sings
shots.music: Chorus 1. Full band; he sings.
shots.visual: Three-quarter medium close-up, and for the first time his beak opens: he sings. On the downbeat of bar 17 the overcast tears open and hard sun falls across him from screen right.
shots.action: Sings "I'm the penguin" with total conviction; chin up
shots.framing: MCU three-quarter front, low angle
shots.light: The light burst on 17.1. Hard sun from the mountain's side (screen right) from here on.
shots.color: The sky wash snaps to clean pale cyan; crisp grey hatch shadows
shots.animation: Lip sync (front-derived mouths on the three-quarter head)
shots.fx: Light burst (the grey overcast wash wipes off right to left in 6 frames)
shots.purpose: The first time he sings; the chorus opens up
shots.head: smirk

shots.title: The orbit
shots.music: Chorus
shots.visual: The camera circles him 120° while he sings, until the mountain stands directly behind his head on the horizon: sunlit, crisp, bigger than before.
shots.action: Sings, eyes on the mountain the whole way (they swing across frame as we orbit)
shots.framing: MS, orbiting from three-quarter front to three-quarter back
shots.move: Orbit 120° over 3 beats, easing into a locked composition
shots.light: Hard sun from the mountain's side
shots.color: Clear
shots.animation: Lip sync; the orbit reveals the parallax of the plain
shots.purpose: "I know where I'm going": the destination is made explicit
shots.head: smirk

shots.title: Heading for the mountain
shots.music: Chorus
shots.visual: Side-on tracking at speed. Sastrugi in the foreground stream past; the mountain holds still on the horizon.
shots.action: Walks and sings, one step per beat, a little bounce in it
shots.framing: MWS side
shots.move: Tracks right with him; strong parallax
shots.color: Clear; navy flipper tips read strongly
shots.animation: Beat-locked walk; lip sync
shots.fx: Sparkle on sunlit snow (P08) on hi-hat eighths
shots.out: Cut on the downbeat to his profile
shots.purpose: Momentum
shots.head: profile

shots.title: Profile match
shots.music: Full chorus; kick strong on the odd bar
shots.visual: Close-up of his head in profile against the sky. It dissolves into the mountain on the horizon, and the two outlines line up: crown and summit dome, beak and summit spur.
shots.action: Sings, then holds still for the dissolve
shots.framing: CU profile, then WS of the mountain at the same screen position and size
shots.color: Clear
shots.animation: 2-beat dissolve centered on 19.2
shots.purpose: Seed 2, the silhouette. It reads as a graphic transition the first time, and as a clue on rewatch.
shots.head: profile

shots.title: The promise
shots.music: Full chorus; the plume lands on the bar-20 downbeat
shots.visual: The mountain in hard sun: the white face blazing, the dark hatched flanks, the summit dome with its jutting spur. A breath plume lifts on the downbeat of bar 20. On "yeah" the sun flares off the white face.
shots.action: None; the mountain is the subject
shots.framing: WS, the mountain at 10% of frame height
shots.color: Clear; the flare is paper white with a pale gold halo (the first hint of warm)
shots.animation: Plume on 20.1; flare on 20.3
shots.out: REC pop on the pickup "We're". The letterbox retracts and the UI pops on.
shots.purpose: Promise, not reveal
shots.head: none

beats.do: sun flare off the white face

shots.title: The clipboard
shots.music: Full chorus; kick lighter in bar 22
shots.visual: The documentary's camera. Three figures in orange parkas block his path. The DIRECTOR steps in and holds up a clipboard: WE'RE MAKING A DOCUMENTARY. A fluffy boom mic dips into frame. On the next line the director flips the page: CAN WE INTERRUPT YOUR JOURNEY?
shots.action: He stops. He looks at the sign, then straight down the lens for exactly one beat, deadpan (sideeye). Then he walks around them and out of frame right. The camera pans late, loses him, and the focus brackets hunt.
shots.framing: Standing-height MS looking down at him; the director's mittens and clipboard in the foreground
shots.move: Handheld; late pan right at the end
shots.color: DOC grade; PARKA orange is the only saturated color
shots.animation: Sign up on 21.1; flip on 22.1; stare 22.1-22.2; he walks on 22.3
shots.fx: Viewfinder UI; focus hunt; boom mic bob
shots.out: Letterbox slam on the pickup "I'm the"
shots.purpose: The documentary interrupts. The deadpan refusal is the joke.
shots.head: sideeye

beats.do: clipboard up: WE'RE MAKING A DOCUMENTARY
flip: CAN WE INTERRUPT YOUR JOURNEY?
he stares down the lens for one beat
he walks around them; late pan; focus hunt

shots.title: Walks on
shots.music: Full chorus
shots.visual: His film again. He walks on toward the mountain, singing. Behind him, small: the director still holding up the sign, and the boom operator turning in a circle.
shots.action: Walks and sings; doesn't look back
shots.framing: WS three-quarter front, the crew behind him
shots.move: Slow track back ahead of him
shots.color: Clear, PARKA specks
shots.animation: Walk; lip sync; the crew's small confused business
shots.purpose: Their film is behind him now
shots.head: smirk

shots.title: Belly flop
shots.music: Full chorus; kick strong on the downbeat of bar 24
shots.visual: He reaches the top of a long white slope that drops toward the mountain. He looks down it, looks at the mountain, and flops onto his belly on the downbeat.
shots.action: Two quick steps, a hop, belly flop on 24.1
shots.framing: MWS side, the slope falling away to the right
shots.move: Locked, then a 4-frame whip down the slope with him
shots.color: Clear
shots.animation: Hop and flop with a squash on landing; a spray
shots.out: Whip follows him into the toboggan shot
shots.purpose: Joy, and he chooses speed
shots.head: smirk

shots.title: Toboggan
shots.music: Full chorus; the high held note starts on beat 4 of bar 25
shots.visual: Tracking alongside at speed as he toboggans down the long slope, legs kicking behind on the beat, flippers out like wings. The ground streams by in motion lines.
shots.action: Toboggans, laughing, kicking once per beat
shots.framing: Low MS alongside
shots.move: Fast track right, slight downward tilt
shots.color: Clear; spray in paper white
shots.animation: Kicks on each beat; body rocks
shots.out: He reaches the wind lip at the bottom and launches, and we cut with him on beat 4
shots.purpose: The joy peak of Act II
shots.head: laugh

shots.title: Airborne
shots.music: The high held note (bar 25 beat 4 to bar 26 beat 1.5)
shots.visual: He sails off the wind lip into the air, silhouetted against the sky with the mountain beyond. Time stretches for the held note. He lands in a spray on beat 1.5 of bar 26.
shots.action: Airborne, flippers spread, beak wide open on "yeah"; lands on his belly and slides to a stop
shots.framing: Low wide, looking up at him against the sky
shots.move: Tilt up with him, then down to the landing
shots.color: Clear sky; he is a black shape with a paper-white rim line
shots.animation: Slow-motion arc; landing spray
shots.purpose: Release
shots.head: laugh

shots.title: Refrain R3 · dusk
shots.music: The chorus tag, on the melody of chorus line 4; kick and bass heavy in bar 27
shots.visual: The Refrain frame. He gets up and walks on while the light changes within the shot: the sun drops, the sky wash turns lilac and rose, and the shadows stretch. The mountain is bigger now. On beat 3 of bar 27, its two dark caves catch the last low sun for six frames, like eyes.
shots.action: Walks, singing the tag
shots.framing: EWS Refrain; the mountain at 10-12% of frame height
shots.environment: The plain, the mountain (M2 to M3)
shots.color: Clean cyan wash turning lilac/rose from the horizon up
shots.animation: Time-lapse light change inside a locked shot; the 6-frame eye glint on 27.3
shots.fx: Eye glint (two paper-white points with a pale gold tint for 6 frames)
shots.out: Dusk into night. The next shot opens in the dark with a REC pop.
shots.purpose: Seed 3, the eyes; day one of the chorus ends
shots.head: profile

shots.title: Don't turn me around
shots.music: Bridge: one line per bar; bass heavy, kick strong
shots.visual: Night. A camp pitched right in his path: a dome tent, a light stand throwing a harsh white cone, headlamps. In the documentary's camera the director picks him up, turns him 180° so he faces back toward the colony, and sets him down.
shots.action: Lifted on beat 1; his feet keep walking in the air, on the beat. Set down facing left (the wrong way) on beat 3. He stands facing the wrong way for one beat.
shots.framing: Standing-height MS, handheld
shots.light: Night; the light stand and headlamps are the only light
shots.color: Navy night wash; light cones are scraped-back paper; PARKA orange; REC red
shots.animation: Lift, rotate, set down; the airborne walk cycle
shots.fx: Viewfinder UI, headlamp flares, breath vapor (P09)
shots.out: Hard jump cut to the same framing
shots.purpose: The famous observation, staged. Turn him around and he heads straight back.
shots.head: annoyed

beats.do: lifted; feet keep walking in the air

shots.title: Don't turn me around (again)
shots.music: Bridge; kick strong
shots.visual: Same framing, a moment later. He has already turned back and is walking past the camp. The director scoops him up and turns him again, faster.
shots.action: Turned around on beat 1. He turns straight back on beat 3 and walks at the camera.
shots.framing: Same as S28
shots.color: Navy, orange, red
shots.animation: Faster repeat; the turn back is a sharp 4-frame pivot on 29.3
shots.out: He walks into the lens. Straight cut to him filling the viewfinder.
shots.purpose: Rule of two; the third time will be different
shots.head: angry

shots.title: Into the lens
shots.music: Bridge; kick and bass drop back (even bar)
shots.visual: He fills the viewfinder, walking straight at the documentary's camera, and sings the line down the lens. It's the first time his beak opens inside the documentary. The camera operator stumbles back; the viewfinder UI tears and glitches; the REC dot flickers.
shots.action: Sings into the lens, hard; flippers back; beak up
shots.framing: ECU in the viewfinder, low and close, handheld reeling back
shots.move: The camera stumbles backward (a 6-frame lurch on 30.3)
shots.color: Navy, REC red; glitch RGB split
shots.animation: Lip sync; the operator's recoil
shots.out: The glitch tears into white noise, which becomes the blizzard
shots.purpose: The documentary's subject talks back. The rule break.
shots.head: angry
sung: Don't care about what you want

shots.title: Refrain R4 · doubt
shots.music: Bridge; kick returns strong
shots.visual: The Refrain frame in a blizzard. Snow in every direction; the horizon, the camp and the mountain are all gone. The right third of the frame, where the mountain always is, is empty. He stands at the left third.
shots.action: He is completely still, the only still shot of him in the film. His head turns slowly back toward the colony (beats 2-3), then slowly forward again (beat 4).
shots.framing: EWS Refrain, locked
shots.light: Night blizzard; faint moon glow through the snow
shots.color: Grey-navy; white snow strokes
shots.animation: Only the head turn and the storm
shots.out: The spin begins from this composition, as the camera rises
shots.purpose: The one moment of doubt, held long enough to count. The empty right third tells it.
shots.head: sad

shots.title: The spin
shots.music: Bridge, two bars; kick lighter in bar 32, strong in bar 33
shots.visual: Overhead, looking straight down on him in the storm. The camera rolls a full half-turn around him over two bars. The storm, the ground, the faint colony lights and the crew's headlamps all wheel around the frame, but he stays pointed the same way, like a compass needle.
shots.action: Sings both lines, planted, defiant, turning only his head to keep his eyes on his heading
shots.framing: Overhead top shot, him at center
shots.move: 180° roll over 2 bars, easing in and out; lands on 34.1
shots.color: Grey-navy; headlamp dots in PARKA orange
shots.animation: Roll; he counter-rotates to stay fixed on his heading
shots.out: The roll lands on the downbeat and the storm tears open in the same frame
shots.purpose: Escalation. They can turn the world; they can't turn him.
shots.head: angry

shots.title: The storm parts
shots.music: Bridge; kick lighter
shots.visual: The storm tears open like a curtain. Moonlight. He stands at the rim of a vast depression of blue ice, too wide to see across. The camera starts to crane up.
shots.action: He steps to the rim and looks down into it
shots.framing: Wide from behind him, rising
shots.color: Navy wash lifting to silver; ICE_BLUE in the depression
shots.animation: The storm peels away left and right in 6 frames
shots.purpose: Something up ahead
shots.head: none

shots.title: The footprint
shots.music: Bridge; line 8 begins on beat 4 of bar 34
shots.visual: Overhead: the depression resolves into a shape: a penguin footprint a hundred meters long, with his exact three toes. He is a dot at its heel. Insert (the downbeat of bar 35): he lifts his own foot and looks at it.
shots.action: He looks down at the print, then at his foot
shots.framing: Overhead EWS, then an ECU insert of his raised foot
shots.move: The crane completes to overhead and locks
shots.color: Silver-navy, ICE_BLUE
shots.animation: The crane settles; the insert
shots.purpose: Seed 4, the footprint. The audience can read it before he does.
shots.head: none

beats.do: insert: his raised foot, same shape

shots.title: Wow
shots.music: Bridge: "wow" is the high held note from beat 2 of bar 35
shots.visual: Close-up. He looks up, and his beak drops open exactly on "wow", the high held note. Moonlight on his face; reflected in his eyes, something enormous.
shots.action: Looks up; beak drops open; pupils at maximum
shots.framing: CU three-quarter, low angle
shots.color: Silver-navy; the aurora's first teal wash creeps into the top of frame
shots.animation: Beak drop on "wow"; a slow blink after
shots.out: Cut on the downbeat to what he sees
shots.purpose: Awe
shots.head: surprised
sung: (extra sung bar, echo of line 8: words to confirm)…

shots.title: Refrain R5 · almost there
shots.music: The extra sung bar; the chorus pickup at the end
shots.visual: The Refrain frame, and the mountain now fills the whole right half of the sky: close, moonlit, the rock hatched, the white face glowing, the two caves dark under the summit. The aurora pours over the summit, and during the bar it folds down into the pink band of dawn along the horizon.
shots.action: He is a tiny figure at the left third, looking up
shots.framing: EWS Refrain; the mountain at 55% of frame height
shots.light: Moon and aurora, turning to dawn
shots.color: Navy and teal aurora washes bleeding into rose at the horizon
shots.animation: Aurora ribbons sway, then fold down into the dawn band
shots.out: The dawn band becomes the next shot's sky; cut on the pickup
shots.purpose: The night ends; the last approach begins
shots.head: surprised
sung: …(extra sung bar, echo of line 8: words to confirm)

shots.title: Dawn
shots.music: Chorus 2
shots.visual: Callback to S17: three-quarter medium close-up, he sings "I'm the penguin", and on the downbeat the first sunlight hits his face, now from over the mountain's shoulder: alpenglow.
shots.action: Sings, stronger than the first time
shots.framing: MCU three-quarter, low angle (same as S17)
shots.color: A rose/peach wash over the paper; the first real warmth in his film
shots.animation: Lip sync; light burst
shots.purpose: The same chorus, a different day. Now it's the last one.
shots.head: frown

shots.title: The orbit, again
shots.music: Full chorus
shots.visual: Callback to S18: the camera orbits him, but this time the mountain behind him is too big for the frame. The orbit also reveals the crew: three orange figures running after him, sinking to their knees in the snow.
shots.action: Sings; strides
shots.framing: MS orbiting
shots.color: Rose wash, PARKA orange
shots.animation: Lip sync; the crew floundering
shots.purpose: Now they're following him
shots.head: smirk

shots.title: Refrain R6 · the foot of the mountain
shots.music: Full chorus; kick strong on the downbeat
shots.visual: The Refrain frame from behind him. The mountain has become the whole frame: its white face rises past the top edge, with no sky left at the right third. He is a small figure at the left third, approaching its foot.
shots.action: Walks toward it
shots.framing: EWS Refrain; the mountain exceeds the frame
shots.color: Peach-pink wash on the white face; blue-grey shadows
shots.animation: Walk; drift
shots.out: Cut on the downbeat to the profile match
shots.purpose: Scale
shots.head: none

shots.title: Profile match, again
shots.music: Full chorus
shots.visual: Callback to S20: his head in profile, and this time a straight match cut to the mountain's summit in profile, filling the frame at the same size. The shapes are unmistakably alike.
shots.action: Sings, then holds
shots.framing: CU profile, match cut to the summit's profile
shots.color: Rose
shots.animation: Match cut on 39.2
shots.purpose: The silhouette seed, repeated where no one can miss it
shots.head: profile

shots.title: The breath
shots.music: Full chorus; the plume lands on the bar-40 downbeat
shots.visual: A slow roll of snow comes down the white face toward him, the summit's breath, and washes over him in a soft wave. Loose snow trickles off ledges from a faint tremor.
shots.action: He stops, closes his eyes into the breath, feathers streaming. He opens them, smiling, and walks on.
shots.framing: MS three-quarter, the face rising behind him
shots.color: Rose; the breath in paper white
shots.animation: Breath roll on 40.1; tremor trickles on 40.3
shots.purpose: The mountain is alive, and it's glad he's here
shots.head: smirk

shots.title: Please?
shots.music: Full chorus; kick lighter in bar 42
shots.visual: The documentary has caught up, barely. Handheld and breathless, with breath vapor fogging the lens edge. The director stumbles into frame and holds up the clipboard: WE'RE STILL MAKING A DOCUMENTARY. On the next line the page flips: PLEASE?
shots.action: He doesn't stop and doesn't look. He walks straight past the sign, out of frame, toward the rock. The camera follows him to the foot of the face, and the focus brackets hunt.
shots.framing: Standing-height MS, handheld
shots.color: DOC grade over the rose wash; PARKA orange
shots.animation: Sign on 41.1; flip on 42.1; he passes on 42.2
shots.fx: Viewfinder UI (battery at one bar, blinking), vapor fog, focus hunt
shots.out: Letterbox slam on the pickup "I'm the"
shots.purpose: The callback. This time he doesn't even stare.
shots.head: frown

beats.do: clipboard: WE'RE STILL MAKING A DOCUMENTARY

shots.title: The first rock
shots.music: Full chorus; mids at their densest from here to bar 47
shots.visual: The first dark rock at the foot of the face, drawn in hatched ink like the model sheet's climbing slope. He reaches it and puts a flipper on it.
shots.action: Sings; places a flipper flat on the rock on beat 1 of bar 43
shots.framing: MCU side, the rock filling frame right
shots.environment: The base of the mountain, rock
shots.color: Rose wash, ink-hatched rock
shots.animation: Lip sync; the flipper contact
shots.purpose: Arrival at the mountain itself
shots.head: profile

shots.title: Looking up
shots.music: Full chorus
shots.visual: Low angle behind him as he looks up. The camera tilts up the face from the rocks, up the white face, and keeps going: it doesn't end.
shots.action: He looks up, sings, and sets his jaw (frown)
shots.framing: Low angle from behind his shoulder
shots.color: Rose, the face graded brighter as it rises
shots.animation: Tilt
shots.out: Cut on beat 2 to the climb
shots.purpose: What's left is up
shots.head: frown

shots.title: The climb begins
shots.music: Full chorus
shots.visual: Side view up a rocky slope, straight from the model sheet's climbing steps 1-3: crouch, reach up, foot up onto the next rock.
shots.action: Climbs, one move per beat, singing in bursts between the effort
shots.framing: MS side, the slope rising left to right
shots.move: Tracks up the slope with him
shots.environment: The rock slope of the mountain's flank
shots.color: Rose wash; grey stipple rock
shots.animation: Model-sheet climbing steps 1-3, beat-locked
shots.purpose: The final effort
shots.head: profile

shots.title: The ledge
shots.music: The high held note (bar 45 beat 2.5 to bar 46 beat 2)
shots.visual: He hauls himself onto a ledge (climbing steps 4-5) and stands up on it with his beak wide open on "yeah". The camera cranes up past him and shows how much face is still above.
shots.action: Pull-up, stand, sing the "yeah"
shots.framing: MS, then the crane reveals a WS
shots.color: Rose
shots.animation: Steps 4-5; lip sync
shots.purpose: The height, sung
shots.head: laugh

shots.title: The tag · sunrise
shots.music: The chorus tag; the lead vocal ends on beat 1.5 of bar 48
shots.visual: From far below at the foot of the mountain: the three crew members, tiny, looking up. High above them on the face, a dark dot climbs. Behind the summit, the sky ignites: the sun is about to rise directly behind it.
shots.action: The crew points up; he climbs, tiny
shots.framing: EWS from the base, looking up the face
shots.color: Rose turning gold at the top of frame
shots.animation: A gold wash grows behind the summit edge
shots.out: Cut on the downbeat as the instrumental hits
shots.purpose: The sun is about to draw the silhouette
shots.head: none

shots.title: Ascending
shots.music: The instrumental climax. No lead vocal; heavy, bass-driven, the loudest bars.
shots.visual: Back view from below, the model sheet's "Ascending (Mid-Action)" pose: he climbs a steep rock face straight up, snow streaming off the rock in the wind.
shots.action: Climbs, one reach per beat
shots.framing: Low angle from below and behind
shots.light: Sunrise rim light on the rock edges
shots.color: Gold rim lines on ink; rose-gold wash
shots.animation: Back-view climb cycle, beat-locked
shots.out: Cut on the downbeat of the loudest bar
shots.purpose: Effort at full volume
shots.head: none

shots.title: The silhouette
shots.music: The loudest bar of the song
shots.visual: The widest shot in the film, from the plain far below. The sun rises exactly behind the summit, and the rim light draws the mountain's whole outline as one continuous gold line: a head bowed on its chest, a beak, sloping shoulders, folded wings. A penguin, two thousand meters tall. On its beak, a dot: him.
shots.action: None; he is the dot
shots.framing: EWS, the mountain centered, full outline in frame
shots.color: The mountain a dark ink mass edged in SUN_GOLD; the sky gold to rose
shots.animation: The rim line traces around the outline over 4 beats, like a pen drawing it
shots.purpose: The audience gets it one beat before he does
shots.head: none

beats.do: rim line starts at the summit

shots.title: Rumble
shots.music: Instrumental climax
shots.visual: Side view, climbing steps 4-6: he steps up onto the highest rocks while small stones tumble past him in a tremor and the breath plume streams overhead.
shots.action: Climbs through the tremor without stopping
shots.framing: MS side
shots.move: Tracks up; a shake on each downbeat
shots.environment: The highest rocks: the base of the beak where it rests on the chest
shots.color: Gold rim, rose wash
shots.animation: Model-sheet climbing steps 4-6
shots.purpose: The mountain is stirring
shots.head: profile

shots.title: Pause and check
shots.music: Instrumental; the soft hum enters on beat 3.5
shots.visual: Back view, the model sheet's "Pause and Check" pose: he stops and looks back over his shoulder. Below him is the whole journey: the plain, one thin line of footprints running all the way back to the horizon, the colony a speck, and the crew, tiny, at the base.
shots.action: Looks back down at everything he left
shots.framing: Over-the-shoulder, high, looking down the face and across the plain
shots.environment: The mountain and the plain below
shots.color: Rose-gold; the plain in blue shadow
shots.animation: The head turn back, a breath, the head turn forward
shots.purpose: "From where I began". The distance, seen whole, from the top.
shots.head: none

shots.title: The beak
shots.music: Instrumental with the soft hum
shots.visual: He pulls himself up onto a long, smooth, upward-sloping ridge of rock and ice (the beak) and stands in the model sheet's "Static (Balanced)" pose. Ahead, where the ridge meets the summit dome, are the two great caves sealed with ice (the eyes), one on each side.
shots.action: Gets up onto the ridge and stands
shots.framing: WS from behind him along the ridge toward the caves
shots.environment: The beak ridge; the brow and the sealed eyes
shots.light: Sunrise just breaking over the brow
shots.color: Gold rim
shots.animation: Pull-up and stand
shots.out: The band cuts out on the downbeat, and the cut goes with it
shots.purpose: The threshold of the reveal
shots.head: none
sung: (slow reprise of the tag: words to confirm, likely '…the creator')…

shots.title: Silence
shots.music: The band cuts out. Pad and a single held vocal note.
shots.visual: Wide, very still. He stands at the top of the beak between the two sealed eyes, each a curved wall of ice taller than a building. The wind drops. Snow hangs in the air.
shots.action: He takes one step forward, then stops.
shots.framing: WS, symmetrical, him centered small between the eyes
shots.color: Rose-gold, very quiet
shots.animation: Particles slow to near-stop (half speed, then a quarter)
shots.purpose: Stillness before the reveal; the song holds its breath
shots.head: none
sung: …(slow reprise of the tag: words to confirm, likely '…the creator')…

shots.title: Cracks
shots.music: The quiet rise toward the top note
shots.visual: Close-up of his face looking up (surprised). Reverse: the ice seal of the nearest eye. Hairline cracks race through it on the rising notes, and snow sifts off the brow.
shots.action: Looks up; his pupils widen
shots.framing: CU, then a reverse CU of the ice seal
shots.move: Locked; slow push on the ice
shots.color: Gold beginning to leak through the cracks
shots.animation: Crack propagation on 54.3, 54.4, 55.1; gold light through the cracks
shots.fx: Crack lines draw on; sifting snow
shots.purpose: Anticipation
shots.head: surprised
sung: …(slow reprise of the tag: words to confirm, likely '…the creator')…

shots.title: The eyes open
shots.music: The song's top note
shots.visual: The ice seals break away, and on either side of him the creator's two eyes open. They are his own eye design, four hundred meters across, lit gold from within. The letterbox bars slide off the top and bottom edges and the frame opens to full height for the first time in the film. Gold light floods the page.
shots.action: He stands between them, tiny, looking from one to the other
shots.framing: Wide, symmetrical; both eyes and him in frame
shots.move: Slow pull-back as the frame opens
shots.color: The whole grade warms; gold wash spreads outward from the eyes
shots.animation: The seals fall away in sheets; the eyes open over 8 frames; the letterbox slides out over 12
shots.fx: Letterbox opening (the frame changes, no cut); gold glow
shots.purpose: "I'm meeting the creator"
shots.head: none
sung: …(slow reprise of the tag: words to confirm, likely '…the creator')

shots.title: Reflection
shots.music: The low final note
shots.visual: Extreme close-up of one enormous eye. In its glassy surface, very small, is the reflection of our penguin looking up. The great pupil contracts slightly as it focuses on him.
shots.action: In the reflection, he raises one flipper, uncertain, a small wave
shots.framing: ECU of the eye filling the frame
shots.color: Ink eye, paper highlight, gold wash
shots.animation: Pupil focus; the tiny wave in the reflection
shots.purpose: It sees him
shots.head: none

shots.title: The greeting
shots.music: The fade, then silence
shots.visual: The creator lifts its head. He is standing on its beak, and he rises with it into the full sunrise, above the clouds. Its eyes cross to look down at the tiny penguin on its beak. He bows, then leans down and touches his beak to its beak. A ring of gold light runs out from the touch across the snow below and all the way to the horizon.
shots.action: Bows; beak touch; eyes close
shots.framing: WS rising with the head; ends CU on the beak touch
shots.move: Rises with the head, then a slow push to the touch
shots.environment: The creator's head against the sunrise
shots.color: Gold, rose, paper
shots.animation: Head lift over 2 s; the cross-eyed look; bow; touch; the greeting ring (P10)
shots.out: Hold into silence, then REC pop
shots.purpose: Recognition and belonging. The emotional peak comes after the last note.
shots.head: laugh

shots.title: The crew
shots.music: Silence and wind
shots.visual: The documentary, far below at the base: the crew stares up, frozen. The camera slides off the operator's shoulder. The image tumbles, hits the snow, and comes to rest tilted.
shots.action: The crew doesn't move. The camera falls.
shots.framing: Handheld MS, then the tumble
shots.move: Handheld, then the fall (12 frames) and a hard stop
shots.color: DOC grade
shots.animation: The tumble; the snow impact
shots.purpose: The documentary finally looks up, too late
shots.head: none

shots.title: The mountain stands
shots.music: Silence, wind, a deep rumble
shots.visual: Very wide, from far across the plain. The mountain stands up. Avalanches pour off its shoulders, its folded wings unfold from the rock, and it pulls its feet out of the ice sheet in fountains of snow. The tiny penguin rides on its head. It turns inland and takes its first step.
shots.action: The creator rises and turns; he rides
shots.framing: EWS
shots.color: Clean paper, pale sky, the eyes' gold
shots.animation: Rise, avalanches (P07), turn, first step
shots.purpose: They leave together
shots.head: laugh

shots.title: The fallen camera · Refrain R7
shots.music: Wind
shots.visual: The abandoned documentary camera, lying tilted in the snow, still recording. The frame is the Refrain composition, tilted. Two figures walk away over the horizon, one enormous and one riding on its head. Their steps land together. They go over the horizon, and the frame is empty: two lines of footprints, one tiny and one colossal. The distance counter goes up.
shots.action: They walk away and disappear
shots.framing: Tilted DOC wide
shots.move: Locked (the camera is lying in the snow)
shots.color: DOC grade; REC red; battery blinking empty
shots.animation: The walk-away; the counter climbing 0.0, 0.1, 0.4, 1.2 KM
shots.out: The battery dies. The image freezes, then the UI blinks out.
shots.purpose: The documentary gets its footage, just not the story it wanted
shots.head: none

shots.title: End card
shots.music: Silence
shots.visual: Paper. Typed one character at a time: "The penguin was not seen again." Beat. "Neither was the mountain."
shots.action: None
shots.framing: Centered text on paper
shots.color: Ink on paper
shots.animation: Typewriter type-on, 3 frames per character
shots.purpose: The documentary's closing caption, and the last joke
shots.head: none
